Package dev.turboism.sdk.cubism.model

Interface RotationDeformer

All Superinterfaces:
Deformer
public interface RotationDeformer extends Deformer
One generation-bound Rotation Deformer with Editor-authoring operations.

Use this specialized view only when the active provider exposes a Rotation Deformer. Its form values are detached immutable snapshots. Writes require verified Editor-authoring support and are unavailable rather than falling back to evaluated/Core mutations.
